title: 5 world market themes for the week ahead
text: 5 world market themes for the week ahead. With the Federal Reserve and the Bank of Japan set to make pivotal interest rate decisions against a backdrop of escalating energy prices, global financial markets brace for change. Meanwhile, BRICS leaders convene in India to explore the integration of central bank digital currencies for seamless payments. In Sweden, the election landscape intensifies, hinting at a surge in far-right political influence.
